quotes.text: Copilot can sound absolutely certain and be completely wrong at the same time. And because it sounds so confident, you might not think to double check it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Names the key risk of AI answers in BI.

quotes.text: Don't rephrase into everyday language. Copilot matches vocabulary, not meaning. So a specific question using the report's own language gets you a consistent correct answer every time.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concrete prompting advice that improves reliability.

quotes.text: Copilot is only as good as your semantic model. Garbage in, garbage out, same as any tool.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Short, memorable rule on data model quality.

quotes.text: Users who treat Copilot as a drafting assistant rather than a finished product have much better results. They don't get burned because they're not trusting it blindly.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical mindset for using Copilot safely.

quotes.text: The right approach is to use Copilot as an accelerator, not a crutch. Let it speed you up, but don't let it think for you.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear recommendation for beginners against over-reliance.

The big gotcha: confident wrong answers
How to ask Copilot the right way

takeaways: Copilot in Power BI drafts DAX measures, builds report pages and answers data questions using your tables, columns, measures and relationships.
It can return confident but wrong and non-deterministic answers, so use the exact terms from your report and always click through to verify the source visual.
Invest in clean names, clear relationships and Prep data for AI, and treat every Copilot result as a rough draft rather than a finished product.
hook: Tried Power BI Copilot once, got a wrong answer and gave up? This episode explains what Copilot in Power BI can and cannot do for report authors, analysts and beginners, and shows how to phrase questions, prepare your data model and verify results so you get reliable answers.
